g.text: EspruinoTools
The JavaScript library and espruino CLI that opens a connection to a board, transforms your code and uploads it over serial, Bluetooth or TCP.
Origin
State
Core
External
`espruino/EspruinoTools` · Gordon Williams · MPL 2.0 · npm package `espruino` 0.1.55
`d3nd3/EspruinoTools` · one docs commit of ours · still 155 behind upstream
EspruinoWebIDE keeps a copy in `EspruinoTools/`, BangleApps in `core/lib/espruinotools.js`
no build step and no tests · `npm test` is a script that errors on purpose
`core/config.js` · chrome.storage.sync, else `localStorage` key `CONFIG`, else a base64 cookie
`-j job.json` · read back into the config object, `configDefaults.json` is the template it writes
`core/env.js` · `process.env` from the board asked 200 ms after connect, memory only, never written
`bin/espruino-cli.js` · the `espruino` bin — upload, `--watch`, `--ide` with a port, `--list`, `--download`
`index.js` · eval()s every non-underscore `.js` in `libs/`, `core/`, `plugins/` into one global
`espruino.js` · the `Espruino` global plus a named processor chain every module hooks into
`core/serial_*.js` · serialport, Web Serial, Web Bluetooth, WebSocket relay, WebRTC, audio modem
`core/serial.js` · 512-byte blocks (or `maxWriteLength` from the device, 19 when slow) with 250 to 500 ms pauses
`core/codeWriter.js` · prompts first, prefixes `x10reset()` and `x10print()`, then polls for `>`
`plugins/` · minify, pretokenise, saveOnSend, setTime, versionChecker, boardJSON, compiler, getGitHub
`core/flasher.js`, `flasherESP8266.js` · STM32 bootloader `0x7F` / ACK `0x79`, and ESP8266
Espruino over serial, BLE, TCP port 23 or a WebRTC peer id
espruino.com/json · board JSON gives pins, firmware links and the real `JSON_URL`
optional noble, serialport, peerjs, ws · a missing one silently disables that transport
EspruinoWebIDE · loads the same files unmodified, which is why they are globals
upstream tree, unmodified
settings, job file, board env
bytes to the board, JSON from espruino.com
